Name: Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Japanese Restaurant[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A Japanese restaurant that adds sushi to Stardew Valley.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]What is inside[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- Gunkanmaki sushi like Salmon Roe, Flying Fish Roe, Cucumber, Tuna and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Nigiri sushi like Tuna Maguro, Salmon Sake, Mackerel Shime Saba, Octmodel, Egg Tamago, Grilled Eel Unagi and more[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Small and large sushi sets with greens[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- All items have food buffs[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]No recipes for now, items are sold directly in the shop. Recipes will be added in a future update.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Perfection Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]This mod does not block perfection even without recipes.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Building Note[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Recommended to build on bigger maps like Spacious Farm, Vast Farm, Massive Farm or other custom farm maps for more space. Can still be built on the vanilla farm map as long as you have enough space on your land.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]- SMAPI 4.0.0 or higher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- DSS[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]1. Install SMAPI, Content Patcher and DSS[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]2. Unzip this mod into your Mods folder[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]3. Run the game with SMAPI[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Works with most content mods.[/b][/size]
